title: Feb 2026 Product Innovation
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-03-18
html:
Below are this month’s new Creator Center features and updates. These are designed to help your agency drive more content output, improve creator monetization, and scale performance more efficiently.

💸 Refundable Sample at Checkout

📌 What it is: Creators can now turn a self-purchase into a Refundable Sample directly at checkout. If eligible, they can toggle “Refundable Sample,” purchase the product, post content, and receive a refund after hitting required sales goals - no seller approval needed. 💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Removes friction in securing products for content
  • Speeds up content production (no waiting on approvals)
  • Increases creator participation in affiliate content
  • Improves conversion by aligning creator intent with product selection

⏩ Agency action: Encourage creators to use this for products they already plan to buy, use for fast-turnaround content or trending products, and incorporate into creator workflows to reduce delays 👉 Learn more in this Feature Guide.

🚀 TikTok Shop Creator Pilot Program Update

📌 What it is: Creators in the program can now post significantly more shoppable videos.

  • <5K followers: up to 3/day (21/week)
  • 5K+ followers: unlimited shoppable posts

💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Unlocks higher content volume and faster testing
  • Enables rapid iteration on hooks, formats, and products
  • Increases chances of finding winning content
  • Supports scaling high-performing creators

⏩ Agency action: Push creators to increase posting frequency, test multiple variations of content quickly, and identify top-performing formats and double down. 👉 Learn more in this Feature Guide.

👀 Growth Actions in Creator Center

📌 What it is: A new personalized recommendation system in Creator Center that suggests next steps based on performance, with clear explanations of what to improve and why. 💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Makes coaching more data-driven and targeted
  • Helps identify blockers to growth faster
  • Reduces guesswork in content and strategy decisions
  • Supports consistent performance improvement

⏩ Agency action: Review Growth Actions during creator check-ins, use insights to guide content and posting strategy, and prioritize actions that unlock GMV growth. 👉 Learn more in this Feature Guide.

✨ Discover: What to Promote Next

📌 What it is: An improved discovery experience in Creator Center that helps creators find products to promote through:

  • New Arrivals
  • Curated Choices
  • Rankings (personalized recommendations)

💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Reduces time spent searching for products
  • Surfaces high-potential and trending SKUs earlier
  • Improves product-market fit for creators
  • Supports more consistent content pipelines

⏩ Agency action: Guide creators to check Discover regularly, align product selection with creator niche and audience, and use insights to plan upcoming content 👉 Learn more in this Feature Guide.

📌 TLDR; This month’s updates focus on:

  • Increasing content velocity (Pilot Program, Refundable Samples)
  • Improving creator decision-making (Growth Actions, Discover)
  • Reducing friction in workflows (faster product access, better guidance)

👉 Focus on helping creators post more, test faster, and choose better products.
